about.p1: Toos Kitchen has been Saihat's barbecue house since 2017 — famous for mandi, waleema platters and charcoal grills, with a rooftop where families gather over generous platters.
about.p2: Zaffran is our sister kitchen — a Pakistani restaurant loved for tandoor-fresh breads, karahi-style grills and hearty breakfast platters, with outdoor seating and a private dining room.
about.title: One family, two beloved kitchens
